findings.message: SA_RESTART used
findings.suggestion: The QNX 8.0 struct sigaction documents sa_flags SA_NOCLDSTOP, SA_NOCLDWAIT, SA_NODEFER, SA_ONSTACK, SA_RESETHAND and SA_SIGINFO only; there is no SA_RESTART. Guard it (#ifdef SA_RESTART) and handle EINTR.

findings.message: Linux /proc path "/proc/sys/crypto/fips_enabled"
findings.suggestion: QNX 8.0 procnto implements /proc with a different layout (/proc/<pid>/ entries such as as, cmdline, ctl, exefile; /proc/self/ is the caller's address space). Linux files under /proc do not map 1:1; QNX docs say not to use /proc in production to control or monitor processes. Review this path manually.

findings.message: Platform branch for __APPLE__ has no __QNX__ case
findings.suggestion: This conditional selects code for other Unix-like systems (BSD/macOS/Solaris/AIX/HP-UX) but never for QNX. qcc defines __QNX__ (800 for QNX 8.0); check whether QNX should take this branch (add `|| defined(__QNX__)`) or the other one (add `&& !defined(__QNX__)`).

findings.message: Linux-only preprocessor condition
findings.suggestion: This branch is Linux-only. qcc defines __QNX__ (value 800 for QNX 8.0; e.g. #if defined(__QNX__) && __QNX__ >= 800); add a QNX branch. __QNXNTO__ is deprecated.
